## WHAT IF LINKEDIN ACTUALLY FELT LIKE MUSIC?

Musicality is a professional discovery network built around sound instead of résumés.

<table>
<tr>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

**Musicians** discover musicians
**Producers** discover singers
**Bands** find members
**Composers** find projects

</td>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

**Studios** find talent
**Labels** discover creators
**Companies** discover creators
**Creators** discover companies

</td>
</tr>
</table>

No résumés. No cover letters. Just profiles built the way an artist actually thinks — genre, sound, taste, and what you're looking to make next.

<br/>

<img src="data:image/png;base64," width="100%" alt=""/>

## DISCOVER PEOPLE LIKE YOU DISCOVER MUSIC.

Users scroll vertically through complete music profiles. Once they reach the bottom of one profile, continuing to scroll transitions naturally into the next — a feed built like a playlist, not a directory.

<div align="center">

<table>
<tr><td>

```
╭──────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                            │
│   MAYA KAPOOR                             │
│   Vocalist • Songwriter                   │
│   Alternative R&B                         │
│   Bengaluru, India                        │
│                                            │
│   LOOKING FOR                             │
│   → Music Producer                        │
│                                            │
│   "If you're obsessed with cinematic      │
│    synths, we'll probably make            │
│    something insane."                     │
│                                            │
│              [ MESSAGE ]                  │
│                                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────╯
              ░░░ next profile ░░░
              ╰──────────────────╯
```

</td></tr>
</table>

**SCROLL ↓ · NEXT PROFILE**

</div>

Three stacked profiles, gradient borders, one continuous feed — discovery that feels like listening, not searching.

## YOUR PROFILE ISN'T A RÉSUMÉ.

Prompt cards, inspired by how people actually talk about music — not how they talk about jobs.

> **THE ARTIST WHO CHANGED HOW I HEAR MUSIC**
> Radiohead changed how I think about production.

> **WE'LL WORK WELL TOGETHER IF**
> You care about weird ideas more than safe ones.

> **MY DREAM PROJECT**
> An orchestral electronic album performed live.

<br/>

## OPPORTUNITY SYSTEM

Users can attach custom opportunity prompts directly to their profile.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  LOOKING FOR                              │
│  🎼 FILM COMPOSER                         │
│  Northlight Studios                       │
│                                            │
│  "We need someone who can blend           │
│   orchestral scoring with experimental    │
│   electronic production."                 │
│                                            │
│              [ REPLY ]                    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

<br/>

### QUESTION → MESSAGE FLOW

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[PROFILE] --> B[QUESTION]
    B --> C[REPLY]
    C --> D[DM CREATED]
    D --> E[COLLABORATION]

    style A fill:#0a0a12,stroke:#FF2BD6,color:#F8F8FF
    style B fill:#0a0a12,stroke:#B65CFF,color:#F8F8FF
    style C fill:#0a0a12,stroke:#8B5CF6,color:#F8F8FF
    style D fill:#0a0a12,stroke:#00C2FF,color:#F8F8FF
    style E fill:#0a0a12,stroke:#00C2FF,color:#F8F8FF
```

<br/>

## MESSAGING

A premium dark-mode DM interface, built around reply-context rather than cold outreach.

```
╭─────────────────────────────────────────╮
│  NORTHLIGHT STUDIOS                      │
│                                           │
│  Replying to:                            │
│  "If you know orchestral + electronic    │
│   scoring, you'll fit here."             │
│                                           │
│                            YOU  ┐        │
│      That's exactly the type of │        │
│      music I make. I've scored  │        │
│      two short films recently.  ┘        │
│                                           │
│  ┌ NORTHLIGHT STUDIOS                    │
│  │ Send us your work.                    │
│                                           │
╰─────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

## DISCOVERY ARCHITECTURE

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    U[User] --> DE[Discovery Engine]
    DE --> PF[Profile Feed]
    PF --> PD[Profile Data]
    PD --> M[Musicians]
    PD --> B[Bands]
    PD --> C[Companies]
    M --> IN[Interactions]
    B --> IN
    C --> IN
    IN --> MS[Message]
    IN --> RP[Reply]
    IN --> SV[Save]
    MS --> RT[Real-Time Messaging]
    RP --> RT
    SV --> RT

    style U fill:#0a0a12,stroke:#00C2FF,color:#F8F8FF
    style DE fill:#0a0a12,stroke:#8B5CF6,color:#F8F8FF
    style PF fill:#0a0a12,stroke:#8B5CF6,color:#F8F8FF
    style PD fill:#0a0a12,stroke:#B65CFF,color:#F8F8FF
    style RT fill:#0a0a12,stroke:#FF2BD6,color:#F8F8FF
```

## DATABASE DESIGN

```mermaid
erDiagram
    USERS ||--|| PROFILES : has
    USERS ||--o{ PROFILE_QUESTIONS : answers
    PROFILES ||--o{ OPPORTUNITIES : posts
    USERS ||--o{ MESSAGES : sends
    USERS ||--o{ CONNECTIONS : forms

    USERS {
        uuid id
        string name
        string username
        string profile_type
        string bio
        string location
        string avatar
        string availability
    }
    PROFILES {
        uuid user_id
        string role
        string genre
        string skills
        string experience
        string looking_for
    }
    PROFILE_QUESTIONS {
        uuid id
        uuid user_id
        string question
        string answer
    }
    OPPORTUNITIES {
        uuid id
        uuid profile_id
        string title
        string description
        string requirements
    }
    MESSAGES {
        uuid id
        uuid sender_id
        uuid receiver_id
        string reply_context
        string message
        datetime created_at
    }
    CONNECTIONS {
        uuid user_a
        uuid user_b
        string status
    }
```

<br/>
